data.one_liner: Drop-in adaptive Material 3 scaffolding and responsive layout widgets for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides drop-in replacements for Flutter navigation and scaffold widgets that adhere to Material 3 adaptive design guidelines. It supports flexible breakpoints, slot layouts, navigation rails, bars, and dual-panel split views.
use_when: You want Material 3 compliant adaptive layouts and navigation elements across multiple form factors.
You need extended styling and configuration options for navigation bars and rails not present in the standard Flutter framework.
avoid_when: You are not using Material Design or prefer a completely custom design system.
You want a completely separate architecture from Flutter's built-in Scaffold and navigation components.
strengths: Drop-in replacement for Flutter framework navigation widgets with enhanced customization.
Comprehensive support for Material 3 small and large badges, tooltips, and themes.
Includes helper widgets like DualPanel, SplitView, and AdaptiveLayout for responsive apps.
weaknesses: Requires resolving name conflicts with standard Flutter framework material widgets via custom imports or prefixes.
Derived from and tightly coupled to Flutter's framework adaptive components.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer auto-scaling and a global responsive layout approach over explicit adaptive structural components.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want widget-level screen size builders and breakpoints without dropping in customized Material scaffold components.
